Optional: put local copies of third-party libs here if you want to work
fully offline (no CDN).

Download and save as:

    marked.min.js     https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js
    purify.min.js     https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3/dist/purify.min.js

Then change the <script src=...> tags in index.html to point to /vendor/.
